title: Criteria scoped to their project
note: A criterion is read in the milestone's own project first, then anywhere: two projects with the same backlog id no longer read each other's, and a path may still read another project's work.

title: Data in every language
note: Each project's own translations laid over its source text, and only its own; addresses fixed from the source.

note: Sixty messages marked where written and resolved per page, counts in the right plural form; left: 'N of M' phrases, table headers.

title: One site per language
note: /en/ and /ru/ with identical paths, old addresses redirecting, the switcher, lang and hreflang; Fluent catalogs.

title: The idea, as an article
note: A project's own idea - an ordered piece of writing for anyone - shown as an article on its Idea tab and by a lens's idea view; the terse cards are named for what they are, concepts and decisions.

title: An index of discovered lenses
note: Curated lenses are the grand projects; every other lens found is shown under Discovered lenses, drawn the same way.

title: Every view a lens
note: How we work and the observatory's own family, built as lenses too. The view kinds ideas and log are drawn.

title: Grand views from lenses
note: Every grand view drawn from its lens.toml with the shared vocabulary: path, matrix, families, runs, backlog, cards, heartbeat.

title: Made by work
note: Each project's 90-day heartbeat, latest release and CI, from ocoeco's gatherers.

title: The path
note: Three horizons, milestones filled by evidence, readiness earned in order.

title: A page per project
note: How close it is, its backlog, log and ideas; cards on the overview.

title: The site
note: The observatory and its family, how we work, ranked tables with a sign in every cell; one stylesheet, inline SVG, no JavaScript.

title: Words never overlap
note: The path redrawn as page layout: a cell per stop, labels whole and wrapping inside their cell, the ladder likewise; a test forbids words inside SVG.

title: How it works, drawn
note: The workings table shown on each project and lens: each milestone with what serves it, how, why we care, and the evidence it produces.
